name: Gaslamp Lumpia Factory
notes: The restaurant's own menu PDF, linked from gaslamplumpiafactory.com/menu and dated AUG 2026. It is image-only — pdftotext -layout and -raw both return 2 bytes — and this machine has no pdftoppm, which is why it was blocked twice. Both pages are embedded JPEGs, extracted with probe/extract_pdf_images.js (new tonight) and read with the Read tool, which works on JPEG. Every price here is printed on the page; nothing was derived. Page 1 is food, page 2 is the drinks menu, and both are included. Add-on lines (sub garlic rice $1.50, add jelly $.75, spicy bbq sauce $.75) are modifiers rather than dishes and were left out; the small/large salads and the glass/bottle wines are recorded as separate rows because the menu prints both. The footer notes a 3% credit-card processing fee, which is a payment surcharge and not part of the listed prices. Address on the site (423 F Street) matches the record.
